title: Wire create-list alert flow in MealPlanDetailView
description: Replace the stubbed shopping-list CTA behavior with the real create-list prompt state, name sanitisation, duplicate-name retry behavior, and service invocation from the meal-plan detail screen.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanDetailView` removes the stub alert state and no longer presents the coming-soon message.
Tapping the CTA opens a `New shopping list` alert with the meal plan name prefilled and create disabled for empty trimmed input.
The view sanitises the name by trimming and replacing `/` with `-` before calling the service.
Duplicate-name failures re-present the create alert with inline error state preserved, and the button disabled rule for empty plans remains unchanged.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria met: (1) removed showShoppingListStub and the coming-soon alert; (2) CTA now opens a "New shopping list" alert prefilled with the plan name, Create disabled when trimmed input is empty; (3) view sanitises name before calling the service; (4) .listAlreadyExists error re-presents the alert with inline error text while preserving the empty-name disable rule.
handoff_summary.risks: The Task in createShoppingList() dispatches file I/O off the main thread — this mirrors the existing loadPlan() pattern and is safe, but tester should verify the re-presentation of the alert after a duplicate-name failure behaves reliably on device (timing of dismiss+re-present). No other risks identified.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify alert prefill, disabled-state behaviour, sanitisation, and duplicate-name retry flow.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only MealPlanDetailView.swift was modified; no shared types or sibling bead file-scope overlap.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: createShoppingList() is synchronous from the view's perspective (returns immediately, work dispatched via Task) to avoid blocking the main thread during file I/O, consistent with the loadPlan() pattern. The view sanitises the name before calling the service even though the service also sanitises internally — this satisfies the AC wording and makes the error message in the duplicate case show the already-sanitised name.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added (developer role). Tester bead should cover: (a) alert prefill = plan name, (b) Create disabled for empty/whitespace-only input, (c) Create enabled after typing, (d) successful creation, (e) duplicate name re-presents alert with error, (f) Cancel clears error state.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Other error cases (readPlanFailed, writeFailed) are silently dismissed. A future polish pass could surface a generic error alert for write failures.

conflict_risks: None — only MealPlanDetailView.swift was modified; no shared types or sibling bead file-scope overlap.

execution_history.summary: Replaced the stubbed shopping-list CTA with a real create-list flow in MealPlanDetailView. The alert prefills the plan name, disables Create on empty trimmed input, sanitises the name (trim + `/`→`-`) before calling the service, and re-presents the alert with an inline error message on duplicate-name failures.
